name: AWS CLI
summary: AWS CLI v2 adds a session ID to the User-Agent header of API requests it sends to AWS. The session ID is a 12-character hash of a machine-specific host ID, the terminal name, and a timestamp, and the CLI's maintainers describe it as an ID for telemetry collection. It is sent to AWS and the request metadata is visible in CloudTrail.

optOut.instructions: Run the export command in each shell where you use the AWS CLI, or add the same line to your shell startup file to make it persistent. Setting AWS_CLI_SESSION_ID_DISABLED to true stops the CLI from storing a session ID.
